jobs.title: Creative Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Job opportunity \- Creative Content Strategist

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: 2–5 years

Function: Branding \& Content

About the role

We’re looking for a Creative Content Strategist who can turn brand requirements, consumer insights and business objectives into strong, distinctive content. You should naturally think in ideas. Given a brief, you should be able to define the idea, why it will work, the right format, how it should look and sound, and what the team needs to do to bring it to life. You don’t need to be a traditional copywriter, designer or editor. You do need a strong understanding of content, storytelling, visual communication and what makes people stop, watch, read and remember.

What you’ll do

● Turn briefs into ideas: Develop concepts, hooks and narratives across brand building, education, entertainment, emotion and product communication. Find interesting ways to make complex or technical subjects engaging.

● Take ideas from concept to execution: Decide the right format — Reel, film, carousel, static, animation, etc. — and define the visual treatment, story, shoot requirements, copy and editing direction.

● Brief and direct creative teams: Create clear briefs and work closely with designers, editors, cinematographers and other creative partners to take an idea from concept to finished output.

● Write and shape the story: Develop or guide headlines, hooks, scripts, VO, supers, captions and CTAs. Know when a story needs more explanation and when fewer words will make it stronger.

● Build and improve content: Identify opportunities for recurring content formats and series. Review creative work, give specific feedback, push beyond the first obvious idea and ensure the final execution delivers on the original thought.

● Protect and strengthen the brand: Translate brand strategy and personality into everyday content while balancing creativity with the need to be honest, credible and easy to understand. Challenge briefs when there’s an opportunity to make the work significantly better.

What we’re looking for

● 4–5 years of experience in content, creative, advertising, brand or digital marketing.

● Someone who thinks in ideas, not just posts.

● Strong understanding of social\-first content, storytelling and visual communication.

● Comfortable moving between strategy, concept and execution.

● Good visual sense, with the ability to articulate what something should look, sound and feel like.

● Understands video, editing and design well enough to direct these disciplines, even if you don’t personally execute them.

● Can write clear, sharp copy and scripts.

● Curious about consumers and understands why people engage with content.

● Can simplify complex subjects into interesting stories.

● Comfortable giving creative feedback and managing multiple projects without compromising the quality of the thinking. You don’t need to be a traditional copywriter, graphic designer, video editor or social media manager. You should understand these disciplines well enough to bring them together into strong creative work.

What good looks like Take a message like:

You should be able to turn it into:

A strong idea → a compelling hook → the right format → a visual/story treatment → a script/copy → a clear execution brief → a great final piece of content.

They come back with 3 genuinely good ideas, each with a clear thought behind it, and know exactly how to make them work.

Portfolio A portfolio is mandatory. We’d particularly like to see:

Pay: ₹700,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Make your mark by using Agentic AI to shape how teams build trusted and AI\-ready data at scale as they go through the Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC). Join the Firmwide Chief Data Office at JPMorganChase where your work directly improves speed, quality, and governance in data delivery. Bring your product mindset and technical fluency to help design a platform that grows your career through high\-impact, enterprise\-wide collaboration.

**Job Summary**


As an Agentic AI Lead for the DDLC at JPMorganChase, you will help build and scale an agentic artificial intelligence solution that enables Data Product Managers to execute the end\-to\-end Data Development Lifecycle (DDLC) – from ideation and modeling through publishing, governance, and consumption. You will translate business needs into a clear technical roadmap, validate engineering delivery, and improve how teams publish and consume governed data products. You will partner closely with engineering and business stakeholders to define success measures, evaluate capability releases, and drive adoption across multiple business areas.


This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, data product delivery, and software engineering execution. Your knowledge of agentic best practices will help build out the architecture for this solution including skills, tools and the harness. Your knowledge of data engineering/science best practices will help translate business needs into technical solutions. **We're looking for a**
**Principal Product Manager \- HR Platforms \& Technology**
===========================================================


**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office****Principal Product Manager \| HR Technology \& Platforms \| Hyderabad**
  

  

**Summary**


Cornerstone OnDemand is seeking a Principal Product Manager to grow our performance and talent management agent portfolio, leading the delivery of AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents that drive measurable customer value.
  

This is a customer\-facing AI\-native product management role for a hands\-on PM who can move quickly from customer discovery and requirements to working prototypes, using modern AI\-native product development tools such as Lovable, Claude, Co\-Pilot and similar platforms. The role requires close collaboration with customers, FDEs, engineering, and cross\-functional teams to validate solutions early, iterate rapidly, and launch outcome agents that solve meaningful business problems. As our agent portfolio grows, individual agents increasingly work together to compound value for customers, and this role will help shape how new agents fit into that broader picture.
  

The ideal candidate is highly execution\-oriented, comfortable working in ambiguity, and able to translate customer needs into prototypes, product direction, and shipped capabilities with speed and rigor


**About the Team**


You'll join a growing product team building AI\-native agents for the performance and talent management domain, part of a broader portfolio of enterprise outcome agents at Cornerstone. Our agents help enterprise customers connect everyday work to business outcomes, from goal\-setting to performance reviews to coaching and development. As the portfolio expands, we're increasingly focused on how individual agents can work together to create more value than any single agent alone. This role is an opportunity to help shape that next chapter, taking ownership of new agent areas as the team grows.


**What Success Looks Like**


In your first 6 to 12 months, you will:
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of one or more new agent initiatives within the performance and talent domain, from customer discovery through working prototype.
* Build strong relationships with customers, FDEs, and engineering partners, establishing a fast, repeatable feedback loop between discovery and prototype iteration.
* Ship a working AI\-native prototype that customers and internal stakeholders can review, test, and validate against real business problems.
* Identify meaningful opportunities for your agent(s) to complement others in the portfolio, contributing to how the team thinks about multi\-agent value.
* Establish yourself as a trusted, execution\-oriented voice on the team, someone who can take ambiguous customer problems and turn them into shipped product direction with minimal oversight

**In This Role You Will**


* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of new AI\-native products and enterprise outcome agents within the performance and talent management domain, from customer discovery and requirements gathering through prototype creation, iteration, and launch.
* Partner directly with customers to understand business problems, workflows, pain points, and desired outcomes in performance management, goal\-setting, and talent development.

jobs.description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft 365 is a cornerstone of Microsoft's cloud strategy and of our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. The Admin Agentic Experiences team owns a strategic, board\-visible bet: making the administrator experience agentic, so that IT professionals can reason, plan, and act across Copilot, Agents, and Microsoft 365 with the trust, safety, and auditability enterprises require.


We are looking for a customer\-obsessed, analytical Product Manager to own a major slice of the Admin Agentic Experiences charter end to end, from strategy through shipped experience. The product is at an inflection point: we are moving from an experience that primarily informs to one that reasons, plans, and acts across Microsoft 365 workloads, at the trust, safety, and auditability bar enterprises require.


 Administrators are the decisive gatekeepers of Copilot and Agents adoption. They decide when a capability is safe, compliant, and ready to roll out. Your work will close the reasoning and actionability gaps these admins are explicitly asking for, and will span scenarios that reach across Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Copilot, Commerce, Message Center, Service Health, and more. The scope carries real ambiguity and demands influence well beyond your own team, so you should be comfortable setting direction where none exists yet and bringing partner teams along with you.

 **Responsibilities*** Own the strategy\-to\-execution plan for high\-frequency, high\-impact admin scenarios, and define what success looks like in measurable terms.
* Engage directly with IT administrators and partners to understand their jobs to be done, and translate that understanding into agentic experiences that reason, plan, and act.
* Define AI\-powered experiences that meet the enterprise bar for trust, safety, grounding, and auditability, working closely with responsible AI and compliance partners.
* Drive cross\-domain orchestration with the Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Copilot, Commerce, and Message Center and Service Health teams to expand persona and scenario coverage.
* Partner with data science and analytics teams to build the telemetry, evaluation, and quality loops that show whether the agent is genuinely helping admins.
* Refine and scope front\-end requirements from deep empathy for the admin journey, delivering experiences that feel simple even when the underlying orchestration is not.
* Build strong working relationships with engineering teams across geographies, and hold a clear bar for on\-time, high\-quality delivery.
* Drive the operational processes for capturing, prioritizing, and removing adoption blockers, and connect the work to downstream outcomes such as Copilot license assignment, sustained usage, and support incident deflection.
* Support our goals for diversity and inclusion through everyday actions and communications.
 **Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in technical or business discipline, or equivalent work experience.
* 4 to 7 years of product management experience, including running complex matrixed programs with detailed product definition and interpersonal negotiation.
* Hands\-on experience with AI and current developments in the field, including practical exposure to building or shipping AI\-powered experiences.
* Demonstrated ability to use data to influence and drive decisions.

 Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, enterprise IT management, or adjacent control\-plane products, and an understanding of what enterprise administrators are accountable for.
* Knowledge of agentic or conversational AI systems, including orchestration, grounding, evaluation, and the trust and safety considerations that come with taking action on a customer's behalf.
* Proven track record of going technically deep and delivering cloud\-scale technologies.
* Skill in navigating complex organizational structures with loose affiliations and competing priorities, and in negotiating common ground to drive prioritization of key deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to listen, distill information into insights, and tailor the message to different audiences from engineers to executives.
* Experience with prototyping or wireframing tools to communicate ideas quickly to stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and make progress in ambiguous environments.
* This is a chance to shape how millions of administrators run Microsoft 365 in an agentic world, on a charter with executive visibility and a real user base. You will work with a growth\-minded group of product managers, engineers, and designers who care as much about the craft of the experience as about the metrics it moves. ******Financial wellness******

******Physical wellness******
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.

 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Working with Engineering Engineering owns the infrastructure and setup. This role owns the application and agentic layer on top of it — and has real influence on how the infrastructure is shaped to support that layer. This role owns: Application, agentic layer, Onboarding \& integration UX, Agent workflows, Tasks, tools, guardrails, Productizing services, Data exchanges, Customer self\-serve. Engineering owns: Asset entity model, MCP, Core data infrastructure, AI, Data flywheel, Data pipelines, Processing standards, Delivery cost. First 90 days

The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.


**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Product Owner is a
 **critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model** 
 , ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

jobs.title: Senior Associate Workforce Planning
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------



Support Operations is one of our core operations teams, responsible for making sure that when things go wrong, there's always someone there to make it right. The team designs, manages, and operates a large and growing global network of support centers, with the goal of delivering a world\-class customer experience every time.



We're looking for an experienced Workforce Planner to help develop and scale our support lines of business. This role is central to planning monthly, daily, and hourly staffing levels, and to keeping hiring plans current so we consistently deliver best\-in\-class service. You'll play a key part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and how we plan around floor staff utilization and efficiency — for a 24/7/365 organization, wherever it operates.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------


**Capacity planning**


* Build and maintain support capacity plan models at the monthly, weekly, and interval level, using a quantitative model to determine the staff required to service forecasted volumes
* Match staffing supply to required staff to ensure efficient service level attainment, and make hiring, ramp, and staff\-reduction recommendations
* Keep capacity plans and assumptions accurate, current, and aligned to source\-of\-truth headcount data, auditing regularly for accuracy
* Ensure alignment from the smallest site/team level of detail up through the broader org\-wide capacity plan
* Maintain documentation of planning methodology, assumptions, and processes, and continually improve the planning tools, models, and templates themselves


**Forecasting \& scenario planning**


* Forecast incoming contact volume using historical and benchmark data, tracking deviations between forecast and actuals on a regular cadence
* Build, update, and present "what\-if" scenarios to evaluate potential changes and support upcoming initiatives, as well as annual, half\-year, and quarterly planning scenarios for long\-range and financial planning
* Build and validate capacity models for new lines of business, queues, or markets, and identify overtime activation needs while ensuring compliance with local labor regulations in each region you support
* Build out and report on seasonality trends for a complex, growing organization


**Performance \& insights**


* Dig into historical data to surface insights that improve support operations, speed, quality, and customer experience
* Monitor service level performance, perform SL\-miss analysis, and feed those insights back into planning


**Staffing \& headcount**


* Guide short\-term staffing adjustments to close current gaps, and partner with Operations to track how staffing is implemented and optimized, driving proactive and corrective improvements
* Reconcile planned vs. actual headcount and budget with Finance/HR, monitor the hiring pipeline against plan, and track new\-hire ramp against expected productivity curves
* Maintain a risk register or contingency plan for capacity gaps such as surges, outages, or attrition spikes, and incorporate attrition, absenteeism, and other shrinkage assumptions into the model


**Cross\-functional partnership**


* Partner with Real Time Analysts for demand insight and outage reporting
* Partner with teams across operations, customer experience, product, engineering, and tools to improve processes and the resulting experience for customers and partners
* Hold regular capacity plan reviews with leadership, and flag service level risks — with supporting analysis and a recommended mitigation plan — for upcoming projects and initiatives
* Own your recommendations end\-to\-end: dig into the data, build the model, set implementation timelines, align partners, test ideas, and measure results

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------


* You're analytical and data\-driven — you love getting into the weeds, and you let data win arguments
* You enjoy tackling complex problems and building something that hasn't existed before
* You're well\-organized and detail\-oriented, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
* You follow up and follow through — you execute and get the job done
* You're comfortable in a fast\-paced, constantly changing, team\-oriented environment, and can manage multiple deadlines at once
* You have an owner mentality: quality\-focused, output\-driven, proactive, and always pushing yourself to do better
* You bring creative solutions to big challenges
* You're comfortable operating at the lowest level of detail while also thinking long\-term and inspiring a team
* You're energized by rapid change and constant learning
* You're comfortable pulling data or modeling in Excel/Google Sheets
* You don't give up — if your first plan doesn't work, you have a few more in your back pocket
* You have 4\-6 years of relevant experience, having succeeded in diverse environments (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or similar)
* You have a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
* You bring hands\-on experience with workforce management software (e.g., NICE, Verint, Genesys, or Aspect) and advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets; SQL experience is a plus

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. jobs.title: Associate Director, Data Systems & AI, Enterprise Competitive Intelligence
jobs.description:
### **Summary**

\#LI\-Hybrid  

  

Location: Hyderabad, India  

  

About The Role:  

Enterprise Competitive Intelligence (ECI) is responsible for gathering, assessing, organizing, and delivering timely, relevant, high\-quality competitive intelligence that supports Novartis pipeline, portfolio, and strategic decision\-making. As ECI moves from a service\-provider model toward a strategic partnership model, the function needs scalable data systems, governed repositories, and AI\-enabled workflows that make validated CI accessible, reusable, and useful across business units.  

  

In this role you will shape and govern the ECI data systems and AI agenda: building and leading the CI knowledge layer, ensuring CI data is available, searchable, API\-ready and usable by AI, and enabling repeatable AI\-assisted workflows that improve speed, quality, consistency and enterprise leverage. The role will act as the bridge between ECI, business\-unit insights teams, Data Digital \& IT (DDIT), enterprise knowledge management teams (e.g. NKC), and relevant external partners to deliver pragmatic solutions while preparing ECI for future AI\-enabled ways of working.
### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Vision and Roadmap**

* Drive the ECI Data Systems and AI vision, roadmap and delivery plan, aligned to ECI priorities, Novartis business\-unit needs and enterprise technology direction.
* Translate ECI’s ambition for a single, trusted CI knowledge layer into sequenced initiatives, milestones, governance forums and investment decisions.
* Maintain a balanced build/buy/partner perspective, evaluating whether capabilities should be built internally, sourced from vendors, or co\-developed with partners.
* Represent Data Systems and AI on the ECI Leadership Team and support ECI Steering Committee discussions on AI, repositories, data governance, interoperability, prioritization and funding.

**CI Repository and Knowledge Layer**

* Lead the design and implementation of the ECI repository / knowledge layer, consolidating curated CI outputs and enabling clear navigation across TAs, business units, congress outputs, Strategic CI, and other CI domains.
* Ensure CI data and outputs are findable, reusable, appropriately tagged and governed, including metadata, taxonomy, ownership, access rights and archival rules
* Drive interoperability with key enterprise and business\-unit systems
* Ensure the repository is not only a document store, but evolves toward an AI\-ready data product that can be consumed by humans, AI agents and other approved enterprise applications.

**AI\-Enabled Workflows and Automation**

* Identify, prioritize and deliver AI\-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and improve quality in recurring ECI activities
* Develop reusable templates, prompts, workflow patterns and validation checkpoints that ECI associates can apply consistently across therapeutic areas and business\-unit requests.
* Partner with ECI leaders and specialists to define future\-state workflows before tool selection, ensuring AI augments expert judgement rather than replacing critical CI interpretation.
* Support pilots and MVPs over validated CI content and potential CI agent capabilities anchored in governed internal data.

**Governance, Quality and Access Management**

* Establish data governance standards for CI assets, including lineage, ownership, lifecycle, metadata, access policies, quality checks and decision rights.
* Ensure CI data is accurate, current, appropriately curated and protected, with expert oversight and clear escalation routes for sensitive or uncertain content.
* Coordinate access management across ECI, insights teams and broader approved user groups, balancing enterprise accessibility with confidentiality, compliance and business\-unit needs.
* Work with Legal, ERC, DDIT, knowledge\-management teams and business owners to ensure AI\-enabled CI workflows comply with Novartis policies, privacy, security and responsible AI expectations.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Enterprise Partnership**

* Serve as the primary ECI interface for data systems and AI topics with business\-unit CI / insights leaders, ECI TA Leads, Strategic CI, DDIT, NKC, and other platform owners
* Build alignment across stakeholders on data standards, workflow priorities, repository design, access model, change\-management needs and success measures.
* Create feedback loops with end users to ensure systems and AI workflows improve usability, relevance, trust and adoption across ECI and its stakeholders.
* Actively promote cross\-BU reuse of CI outputs and reduce duplication by making the right intelligence easier to find, compare and apply.

**Delivery, Vendor and Financial Discipline**

* Run a lightweight but rigorous delivery model across Data Systems and AI workstreams, including backlog management, MVP demos, milestone tracking, dependency management and risk escalation.
* Evaluate and manage vendors and pilots in the AI for CI space, including clarity on expected value, data requirements, procurement implications, integration feasibility and exit criteria.
* Manage the Data Systems and AI budget / project spend once approved, supporting timely forecasting, vendor decisions and efficient allocation of scarce resources.
* Help ECI leadership make transparent trade\-offs across repository build, AI workflow development, vendor pilots, external data feeds and internal technical capacity.

**Talent, Capability Building and Change Management**

* Build ECI capability in data systems, AI literacy, prompt/skill development, responsible AI use and data governance fundamentals.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.


**Leadership \& Coaching**
* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Partnership**
* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.


**Roadmap, Backlog \& Delivery Governance**
* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:
+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Alexa\+ is the world's best Generative AI powered personal assistant / agent for consumers. We are seeking an experienced and entrepreneurial Senior Product Manager – Technical to lead key monetization initiatives for Amazon Alexa\+. This is primarily a technical product management role, with a secondary go\-to\-market and product marketing responsibility (approximately 80% product management, 20% product marketing).
  

  

This product leader owns what we build and why. They have a successful track record of leading product initiatives from concept to launch, working backwards from customers, and making product decisions grounded in direct customer understanding and data. The ideal candidate is a self\-starter with excellent product management skills, a strategic thinker who engages deeply with engineering on architecture and technical tradeoffs, and a strong communicator with excellent cross\-org collaboration skills. Experience in the following domains is preferred: e\-commerce, online advertising, search, AI powered personal assistants, personalization, and generative AI powered products.
  

  

As a Senior Product Manager – Technical for Alexa\+ Monetization, you will drive product strategy, product definition, design, launch, and product decision\-making for mission\-critical monetization initiatives. You will own the product roadmap and the input and output metrics that define success. You will spend the majority of your time on core product management, and you will additionally own the go\-to\-market and product marketing motion — positioning, messaging, and sales enablement — required to bring your products to internal ad sales teams and external advertiser/agency customers. You will maintain ownership across the full product life\-cycle. Your work will impact hundreds of millions of customers worldwide and drive significant growth for Alexa\+.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Product management (primary, \~80%)
  

  

Own product decisions for Alexa\+ Monetization initiatives — deciding what to build and why, and holding decision authority across the product life\-cycle.
  

  

Drive the development of product strategy and create buy\-in for the plan across the Alexa organization and partner teams in Amazon.
  

  

Create and own product roadmaps for the key areas you are leading.
  

  

Work backwards from customers: conduct and synthesize direct customer research, observe consumer behavior, and use customer and market data to define product direction.
  

  

Engage deeply with engineering on system architecture and technical tradeoffs, influencing technical design decisions to meet customer and business goals.
  

  

Define, instrument, and own both input metrics (the levers you control) and output metrics (business outcomes) for the products you lead.
  

  

Develop detailed business requirements, user stories, and product specifications.
  

  

Partner with engineering and partner teams to drive product launch and business growth.
  

  

Product marketing / go\-to\-market (secondary, \~20%)
  

  

Own product positioning and messaging for the products you lead, and partner on go\-to\-market collateral and sales enablement for internal ad sales teams and external advertiser/agency customers.
  

  

Support go\-to\-market execution for launches and help create buy\-in for the GTM plan across Alexa Ads and Amazon Ads sales teams.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* 7\+ years of technical product management experience, leading products from concept to launch.
* Track record of making product decisions grounded in direct customer understanding and data.
* Demonstrated ability to engage with engineering on architecture and technical design tradeoffs.
* Experience defining and owning input and output metrics for a product.
* Experience leading teams and cross\-org stakeholders through influence rather than authority.
* Outstanding written and oral communication skills.
* Strong quantitative data analysis and critical thinking skills.
* History of teamwork and willingness to roll up one's sleeves to get the job done.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
* Experience in e\-commerce, online advertising, search, AI powered personal assistants, personalization, or generative AI powered products.
* Experience owning or contributing to go\-to\-market, product positioning, and sales enablement for advertising or software products.

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Simpplr is the AI\-powered intranet for unifying the digital workplace. It brings people, trusted knowledge, apps, and agents into a coherent digital experience. Powered by a proprietary EX Knowledge Graph, Simpplr synthesizes signals and context across connected systems to deliver personalized information and actions. The platform serves as a digital hub supporting communications, engagement, employee services, and work. With low\-code extensibility and enterprise\-grade security and governance, Simpplr enables confident operation at scale. More than 1,000 organizations — including AAA, the NHS, Penske, and Moderna — trust Simpplr to keep their workforce informed, aligned, and productive. Learn more at simpplr.com.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a highly skilled
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to join our
 **Product Management team** 
 . In this role, you’ll help shape the future of our AI platform by defining, building, and scaling AI\-powered capabilities that improve employee experience across the Simpplr platform.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, product managers, and cross\-functional teams to deliver intelligent features, services, and models that power personalized, contextual, and action\-oriented experiences for our users. From AI\-driven content discovery and conversational experiences to intelligent automation and predictive insights, you’ll help drive the strategy and execution behind the next generation of AI capabilities for Simpplr.
   

  

 This role requires good technical fluency in AI and ML concepts, APIs, and enterprise SaaS products. You’ll be responsible for translating complex AI capabilities into scalable product features that drive tangible customer outcomes.
   

  

**Your job responsibilities: what you will be doing**
* Collaborate with engineering and product leadership to define and execute the roadmap for Simpplr’s AI platform, services, and agentic capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and designers to identify high\-impact AI use cases across the employee experience platform, ensuring alignment with customer needs, business goals, and platform strategy.
* Define product requirements, user stories, evaluation criteria, and success metrics for AI\-powered features, agents, services, and platform capabilities.
* Work closely with AI engineers, architects, and data scientists to translate product requirements into AI models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and enterprise integrations.
* Drive the development of reusable AI platform primitives including model gateways, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, knowledge retrieval, observability, governance controls, and agent tooling.
* Establish evaluation frameworks to assess AI quality and performance, including offline and online evaluations, golden datasets, regression suites, LLM\-as\-a\-judge methodologies, trajectory scoring, and user feedback loops.
* Define AI platform standards for reliability, scalability, and operational excellence, including monitoring, failure handling, retries, fallbacks, graceful degradation, and cost optimization.

We build state\-of\-the\-art information retrieval infrastructure, extracting structured\-data from unstructured\-content, automatic item classification, storage systems to hold the massive catalog and distributed systems of cloud\-scale. We apply parallel processing, Generative AI solutions, and machine learning algorithms to evaluate millions of products every day and to identify and prioritize new additions to Amazon’s selection efficiently. If you are customer obsessed, driven, tenacious and analytical, you will have fun solving our business problems of unprecedented scale. You will develop deep technical expertise and learn designing large scale distributed, service\-oriented systems. Come join us in our journey to improve our customer experience at Amazon !
   

  

 Our ideal candidate will have launched multiple, impactful consumer products, have demonstrated the ability to lead high\-performance teams, and have deep understanding of product management, user experience, and software development processes (especially agile). You should be highly analytical, able to work effectively across teams, and thrive in entrepreneurial, fast\-paced work environments.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead product strategy and vision supported by internal data and external analysis.
* Define creative, high quality, simple product requirements and roadmaps based on product strategy.
* Manage prioritization and trade\-offs among customer experience, performance and operational support requirements.
* Create buy\-in for the product vision both internally and with key partners
* Work closely with engineering teams to deliver products to market using agile development methodologies.

* Measure and analyze existing products and business models for opportunities to innovate and improve, providing additional benefits to developers and customers

**About The Team**
 Amazon carries the world’s largest catalog of products and in order to maintain this lead, we are constantly exploring and understanding the global e\-commerce landscape. The mission of Selection Monitoring (SM) team is to collect all publicly available facts and generate insights about brands and products. SM is a global team with the charter to surface these facts and insights to WW Amazon teams where we have an e\-commerce business. SM’s primary objective is to improve Amazon selection and customer experience by discovering, validating, prioritizing off\-Amazon brands and selection.

* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Mem0**
==============


We're building the memory layer for AI agents: long\-term memory that lets AI remember conversations, learn from interactions, and build real context over time, the difference between a chatbot and something that actually knows you. We're already powering millions of AI interactions for enterprise customers and a fast\-growing open\-source community (160k\+ developers and counting).


We're backed by top\-tier investors through a $24M Series A \& Seed, early enough that the systems you build now become the foundation everything else is built on.


This role owns the backend behind that platform. You'll design clean REST APIs, model data across relational and graph stores, and operate services in production. When customers hit issues, you'll chase them down to root cause, ship fixes, and harden the system, working closely with frontend and research to deliver fast, reliable features.


You'll design the core systems, decide how they're built, and stay with them through production. Our users are developers integrating us into their own agents, which means the APIs you design are the product as far as they're concerned.


This role reports directly to Deshraj Yadav, our Co\-founder and CTO, and works closely with the engineering team in San Francisco.

**What you'll do**
==================

* **Design \& ship REST APIs:** Define contracts, versioning, auth, rate limits; write migrations and docs.
* **Model data \& schemas:** Relational (Postgres) and graph (e.g. Neo4j); enforce integrity and performance.
* **Debug customer issues end to end:** Trace with logs, metrics and traces, reproduce, fix, and write preventative guardrails.
* **Optimize performance:** Tune slow SQL with EXPLAIN/ANALYZE, indexes, partitioning, pagination, and caching (e.g. Redis).
* **Build services in Python:** Async where it helps (FastAPI, Django/DRF, Flask), background jobs, queues, schedulers.
* **Operate in the cloud:** Containerize with Docker, deploy on Kubernetes (EKS), and use AWS primitives (EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM).
* **Instrument everything:** Custom metrics, structured logging, tracing; set SLOs and alerts (CloudWatch/Prometheus/OpenTelemetry).
* **Collaborate \& ship:** Work with frontend and research to scope APIs and deliver features to production.

**Minimum qualifications**
==========================

* 5\+ years building backend systems and shipping REST APIs to production.
* Strong Python fundamentals; experience with async programming and a major web framework (FastAPI/Django/Flask).
* Solid data modeling and SQL skills; hands\-on with query tuning and performance debugging in Postgres/MySQL.
* Experience with graph databases (e.g. Neo4j or Amazon Neptune) and the data modeling trade\-offs that come with them.
* Comfortable running services on AWS with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Demonstrated root\-cause analysis and ownership from incident to prevention.
* Clear communicator and effective collaborator with frontend, research, and customers.

**Nice to have**
================

* GraphQL/gRPC; event\-driven systems (SNS/SQS/Kafka) and background workers (Celery/RQ).
* Caching, rate limiting, multi\-tenancy, and feature\-flag strategies.
* Security \& privacy best practices (PII handling, secrets management).
* Deep observability experience (OpenTelemetry, SLO\-based alerting).
* Prior work with search/retrieval or memory systems.
* On\-call experience and running blameless postmortems.
* Prior time at an early\-stage startup. Series A, YC, or founding engineer experience tells us a lot.

**Our culture**
===============

* **Velocity with craftsmanship:** We build for the long term, not just shipping features. We move fast but never sacrifice reliability or thoughtful design. Every system needs to be fast, reliable, and elegant.
* **Extreme ownership:** Everyone at Mem0 is a builder\-owner. If you spot a problem or opportunity, you have the agency to fix it. Titles are light; impact is heavy.
* **High bar, high trust:** We hire for talent and potential, then give people room to run. Code is reviewed, ideas are challenged, and wins are celebrated, always with respect and curiosity.
* **Data\-driven, not ego\-driven:** The best solution wins, whether it comes from a founder or an engineer who joined yesterday. We let results and metrics guide our decisions.

**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Gracenote, a Nielsen company, is dedicated to connecting audiences to the entertainment they love, powering a better media future for all people. We are the content data business unit of Nielsen that powers innovative entertainment experiences for the world’s leading media companies. Our entertainment metadata and connected IDs deliver advanced content navigation and discovery to connect consumers to the content they love and discover new onesGracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.
   

  

* We are hiring a lead product manager to own this platform from our Bengaluru engineering center. This role has a deliberate arc.
* Initially, this is a hands\-on role. You will write specs and requirements yourself, work directly with engineers and data architects, analyze data with your own queries, and build deep fluency in the platform. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work.
* As the platform and your fluency mature, the role expands into a player\-coach position, which will build and mentor a product team in India while remaining close to the platform. Candidates should be excited by both halves of this trajectory, not just the second one.
* You will be the lead product presence co\-located with our engineering organization, partnering across time zones with Dataset and Delivery Product Managers and commercial stakeholders based in the US and Europe. This is not a satellite role. It is that the product anchor for our engineering center.
* An ideal candidate will have 8\+ years of Product Management experience and a proven track record of end\-to\-end ownership and delivering results.


**Responsibilities**
* Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for Gracenote's Data Platform, the system that structures and models complex TV entertainment data for internal consumers and clients alike.
* Work closely with Global Dataset and Delivery Product Managers to understand the business problems in creating and structuring complex entertainment data, and translate those needs into a clear, prioritized roadmap.
* Partner directly with engineering teams and Data Architects to shape data models, write detailed requirements, and drive hand\-on execution, especially in the first phase of the role.
* Define and own the platform's key input and output metrics. Establish platform SLAs and quality measures, and publish them so internal and external consumers can hold the platform accountable.
* Operate effectively across a globally distributed organization: strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US/EU stakeholders.
* Over time, hire, mentor, and grow a high\-performing product team in India while remaining an active individual contributor on the most complex platform problems.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of product management experience, including 3\+ years on platform or data products.
* Demonstrated appetite for hands\-on IC work at a senior level: writing specs, querying data, working directly in the details with engineering.
* Actively uses LLMs in day\-to\-day product work: to accelerate analysis, drive better decisions, automate repetitive PM tasks, and achieve measurable outcomes. Be prepared to walk through concrete examples in the interview.
* Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL, and REST APIs; able to write or LLM\-assist your own scripts in Python or SQL to answer product questions.
* Experience working within structured, milestone\-driven development processes and delivering predictably against commitments.
* Highly metrics\-driven: able to distill a complex platform into a small set of key input and output metrics and use them to drive decisions.
* Track record of driving execution rigor in collaboration with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication; proven ability to influence stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* Interest and aptitude for people leadership: prior mentoring, coaching, or team\-lead experience, and genuine motivation to build a team as the role grows.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.


**Preferred Skills/Experience**
* Experience with TV/entertainment metadata, EPG data, content supply chains, or adjacent media data domains.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.
* Prior experience as a hiring manager or formal people manager.


**Additional Information**

Job Title: Digital Marketing Analyst

Department: Digital Marketing / Marketing

Location: Bengaluru

Reporting To: Head – Digital Marketing

Job Summary

The Digital Marketing Analyst will be responsible for analyzing digital marketing performance, tracking campaigns, generating actionable insights, and supporting data\-driven decision\-making. The role will work closely with the Digital Marketing, Admissions, Sales, CRM, and Creative teams to improve lead generation, campaign performance, conversion rates, and overall marketing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Campaign Performance \& Analytics

Monitor and analyze performance of Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other digital campaigns.

Track key metrics such as impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, CPL, conversions, conversion rate, and ROI.

Identify high\- and low\-performing campaigns, ad sets, keywords, audiences, and publishers.

Provide recommendations to optimize campaign budgets and performance.

2\. Lead \& Conversion Analysis

Analyze leads generated through different digital channels, publishers, landing pages, and campaigns.

Track the complete lead journey from Lead → Application → Application Paid → Submitted → Verified → Enrollment/Admission.

Identify lead quality, drop\-off points, and conversion trends.

Analyze source\-wise and campaign\-wise admission performance.

3\. CRM \& Data Analysis

Work with CRM platforms such as LeadSquared to extract and analyze lead and admission data.

Ensure accurate mapping of lead sources, campaigns, stages, and conversion data.

Identify data inconsistencies and coordinate with CRM/technical teams for resolution.

Maintain data hygiene and ensure reports are accurate and up to date.

4\. Reporting \& Dashboards

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly digital marketing performance reports.

Create dashboards and MIS reports for management.

Provide insights on campaign spending, lead generation, lead quality, applications, admissions, and ROI.

Present key findings and recommendations to the Digital Marketing and Admissions leadership.

5\. Tracking \& Attribution

Monitor tracking mechanisms such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, pixels, and UTM parameters.

Ensure proper attribution of leads and conversions to the respective marketing channels.

Identify tracking gaps and coordinate with technical teams to resolve them.

6\. Landing Page \& Funnel Analysis

Analyze landing page performance, traffic, engagement, conversion rates, and drop\-offs.

Recommend improvements to landing pages and lead\-generation forms.

Conduct A/B testing analysis where applicable.

7\. Market \& Competitor Analysis

Track digital marketing trends and competitor campaigns.

Analyze competitor presence, messaging, keywords, offers, and digital strategies.

Provide insights to improve the university's digital marketing strategy.

Required Skills

Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Good understanding of Google Ads and Meta Ads.

Strong knowledge of Google Analytics/GA4, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

Experience with CRM and lead\-generation platforms, preferably LeadSquared.

Advanced knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets.

Knowledge of dashboards and visualization tools such as Power BI, Looker Studio, or similar platforms.

Understanding of digital marketing KPIs and performance marketing.

Ability to analyze large datasets and identify meaningful trends.

Strong communication and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Marketing, Business Analytics, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field.

2–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing Analytics, Performance Marketing Analytics, Business Analytics, or a similar role.

Experience in the education/EdTech sector is an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Cost Per Lead (CPL)
* Lead\-to\-Application Conversion Rate
* Application\-to\-Admission Conversion Rate
* Cost Per Admission (CPA)
* Marketing ROI / ROAS
* Lead Quality
* Campaign Conversion Rate
* Data Accuracy \& Reporting Efficiency
* Landing Page Conversion Rate
* Channel/Publisher Performance

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate should be data\-driven, detail\-oriented, commercially aware, and comfortable working with large volumes of marketing and admissions data. The person should be able to convert raw campaign and CRM data into clear insights and actionable recommendations that help improve lead quality, admissions conversion, marketing efficiency, and ROI.

Pay: Up to ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Job Description
**Job purpose**


We are seeking a highly motivated and delivery\-oriented Business Analyst to support a large\-scale middle\- and back\-office transformation and migration program for a leading institutional capital\-markets client. The role spans a variety of asset classes — FX, rates, fixed income, financing, derivatives and options — and sits strategically at the intersection of business, operations and technology. The ideal candidate thrives in complex environments and can translate business and operational needs into clear, actionable requirements, is passionate about improving operational workflows and platform capabilities, and brings strong organizational and multitasking abilities in fast\-paced settings. The Business Analyst will partner closely with Product Owners, operational SMEs, technology and QA teams; familiarity with external post\-trade vendor platforms and how they could synergize with this initiative is a significant advantage.


**Key responsibilities**


* Partner with Product Managers, business stakeholders and operational SMEs to define platform capabilities, business requirements and target operating models for middle\- and back\-office functions.


* Analyze and document functional and non\-functional requirements for large\-scale system migration initiatives.


* Support end\-to\-end migration activities including current\-state analysis, gap assessments, process mapping, data mapping, reconciliation planning and business readiness.


* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Compliance and Technology teams to understand workflows and operational dependencies.


* Translate complex business processes into user stories with clear acceptance criteria and functional specifications.


* Facilitate refinement sessions across business and technology stakeholders at various levels.


* Support product\-roadmap execution by helping prioritize enhancements, operational efficiencies and migration deliverables.


* Coordinate testing activities iteratively through the SDLC, and assist with data validation, reconciliation and migration cutover planning.


* Identify risks, dependencies and process impacts associated with platform\-transformation initiatives.


* Contribute to change\-management, training and operational\-readiness activities.


* Ensure solutions align with regulatory, audit and operational\-control requirements.


**Key competencies**


* 10\+ years of Business Analyst experience within Capital Markets, preferably in the institutional space.


* Knowledge of financial products including equities, fixed income, derivatives, FX and securities financing.


* Strong understanding of middle\- and back\-office operations across the entire trade lifecycle (settlements, reconciliations, accounting, confirmations, margin management and reporting).


* Experience supporting large\-scale system implementations, platform migrations or transformation programs.


* Proven ability to work in Agile, hybrid or enterprise delivery environments, and comfort operating within an Agile/Scrum/Sprint framework using JIRA.


* Strong requirements\-gathering, process\-mapping and documentation skills, with experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications.


* Excellent stakeholder\-management and communication skills across business and technology teams, with strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.


**Preferred qualifications**


* Experience supporting vendor\-platform implementations or strategic modernization programs.


* Experience with post\-trade vendor platforms such as Broadridge, Murex, Calypso, Aladdin, Charles River or similar ecosystems.


* Familiarity with operational risk, controls and regulatory\-reporting requirements.


* Experience working with cloud\-based or distributed\-architecture transformation initiatives.


* Product mindset with a strong focus on user outcomes and operational efficiency.

**Domain\-Specific Responsibilities (NDC \& GDS):**

**Integration And Transition**

* Delivering comprehensive gap analyses that allow the engineering team to transition GDS workflows to NDC APIs smoothly without disrupting current booking volumes or revenue streams.


**Requirement Efficiency**
* Maintaining high\-quality Agile backlogs where user stories, data mappings, and acceptance criteria are so clearly defined that development velocity increases and rework due to misaligned requirements is minimized.


**Job Skills/Competencies/Experience**
* 6 to 7\+ years of professional experience working as a Business Analyst, with a heavy focus on the Air Travel, Corporate Travel, or Travel Technology sectors.
* Hands\-on experience with GDS platforms (Amadeus, Sabre, or Travelport) and NDC API integration projects is strictly required.
* Familiarity with Online Booking Tools (OBTs like Concur, Cytric, Deem) and corporate travel management workflows is highly preferred.
* Extensive experience working within Agile/Scrum development frameworks (Jira/Confluence proficiency).
* An analytical mind with a proven problem\-solving aptitude for diagnosing complex XML/JSON payloads, fare calculations, or booking API failures.
* Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills, with the ability to take initiative and champion innovative ideas.
* Fluent and highly effective English communication skills (both written and verbal).


**Qualifications**
* 6 to 7\+ years of professional experience working as a Business Analyst.
* In\-depth knowledge of airline distribution mechanics, including IATA standards, NDC schemas and GDS workflows.
* Proven ability to use multiple business analysis elicitation techniques to bridge communications seamlessly between business stakeholders and IT developers.
* Self\-starter with excellent time management skills, capable of working independently and flexibly within a global environment spanning multiple time zones.
* Ability to see the “big picture” relationships between different distribution technologies and corporate booking engines.
* Advanced skills in Excel (data modelling), PowerPoint (stakeholder presentations), and Word/Confluence (functional specifications).
